package.name: realsense_fast_mesh_baseline
package.description: Vanilla single-frame mesh baseline. Subscribes to an organized depth PointCloud2, runs pcl::IntegralImageNormalEstimation + pcl::OrganizedFastMesh, and publishes a visualization_msgs/Marker (TRIANGLE_LIST) with per-vertex slope coloring. Acts as the reference "what does PCL give us for free?" baseline against which custom mesh / surfel work is compared.
